I can't compute these numbers because the data isn't in the working directory. The directory has no IURC orders and no case data. It holds only shell and editor configuration files (`.bashrc`, `.zshrc`, `.vscode` and similar) and Claude settings files. The listed dotfiles are character-device stubs, not readable files, so none of them could hold order text.

Here is what I can't supply:
- **(a)** The share of non-utility respondent cases with a headline penalty of at least $5,000, for 2023 and for 2024.
- **(b)** The share of all cases that are utility respondent cases, for 2023 and for 2024.

I haven't guessed at any figures. Any number I gave would be invented, not an estimate grounded in the orders.

If you add the 58 orders (PDFs or extracted text) or a table of their cases, I'll compute all four percentages to one decimal. The table would need respondent name, order date, and the recommendation text.
